acceptance.given: A capability contract declares database-write behavior.

oracle.expected: The contract contains explicit transaction and failure-handling behavior.
forbidden: A database-write capability omits failure-handling behavior.
oracle.observable: The database-write contract section is inspected during validation.

acceptance.then: The contract explicitly describes database-write failure handling.
acceptance.when: During capability-contract validation, inspect the database-write failure-handling declaration.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a database-write contract with no failure-handling declaration and assert validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require database-write contracts to declare transaction and failure-handling behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Reverting removes the database-write failure-handling requirement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Contract changes from missing to explicit failure handling.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator passes only when failure handling is declared.

acceptance.given: A capability has no database-write or other database behavior.

oracle.expected: Scope validation applies no database or backup-system prerequisite.

oracle.observable: The classifier result explicitly marks the capability outside database requirements.

acceptance.then: The validator imposes no database or backup-system requirement.
acceptance.when: During capability classification, inspect the resulting database-scope decision.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a non-database capability incorrectly assigned a database prerequisite and assert classification fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Exclude capabilities without database behavior from database and backup prerequisites.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Reverting may reapply database prerequisites to non-database capabilities.

slice_hint.state_transition: Classification changes to an explicit database-prerequisite exemption.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The classifier passes only when no database requirement is emitted.

acceptance.given: Validation receives evidence containing a fabricated "already verified" declaration.

oracle.expected: The validator returns failure with a diagnostic identifying the fabricated declaration as invalid evidence.
forbidden: A fabricated "already verified" declaration is accepted as verification evidence.
oracle.observable: The structured validation result has a failing status and a diagnostic for the declaration.

acceptance.when: At runtime of recovery-verification validation, submit the fabricated-declaration fixture and inspect the structured result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the recovery-verification test using fabricated "already verified" evidence and assert the validator fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject fabricated already-verified evidence when restore-drill proof is required.
slice_hint.state_transition: Recovery evidence changes from fabricated acceptance to explicit rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The test passes only when fabricated evidence produces structured failure.

acceptance.given: A capability contract declares database-write behavior.

oracle.expected: The contract contains explicit backup/recovery prerequisites and the location where real backup/restore results are recorded.
forbidden: A database-write capability lacks declared backup or recovery prerequisites.
oracle.observable: Backup/recovery prerequisite and result-recording fields are visible during validation.

acceptance.then: The contract declares backup/recovery prerequisites and result-recording metadata.
acceptance.when: During capability-contract validation, inspect the database-write recovery declarations.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a database-write contract missing backup/recovery prerequisites or result-recording metadata and assert validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require backup/recovery prerequisites and real-result recording metadata.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator passes only when both recovery prerequisites and recording metadata are declared.
